signature.what: every line starting `**Signed by Sergi:` in PLAN_CORRECTIONS.md, of which there must be at least 1. A gate that stopped at the first would report ok over an unsigned amendment.

provenance: POST-RUN: asked for by Sergi on 2026-11-14, after corrections/fall.py. The expectation in the module's docstring was written and committed before the reading ran. Not a signed row; no verdict moves.
added_after_the_first_run: Added after the first run, after its five clauses were read: each pair cut again with the wrong and the even crossings taken out, the rules above the even crossings, and the same births replayed with an engine that refuses an edge only where its cycle runs through rules that all match a point the edge decides. Both were tried in a scratch script first. No expectation; no clause moves.
surface: the refused right sides at the points lost by a conflict after each run's peak, as fall.json reads them; their paths over the whole space
